name: FireHydrant
summary: FireHydrant's free plan covers up to 10 responders with a Slack and Teams chatbot and one status page. Pro costs $25 per responder a month billed annually and adds on-call scheduling, with SMS and voice sold separately.

facts.text: Pro lists on-call scheduling, unlimited escalation policies, unlimited webhooks and alert rules, and one retrospective template.
The Signals alerting product is charged by the number of alerts sent, and the pricing page publishes no per-alert price.
A 14-day Pro trial needs no credit card.
FireHydrant states SOC 2 Type II compliance and gives September 2021 as the date it achieved it.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 10 responders, 2 runbooks, Slack and Teams chatbot, 1 public status page, 3 integrations

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually; no monthly option is published. SSO included

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Adds live call routing, SCIM and unlimited retrospective templates

hiddenCosts: SMS and voice notifications are available for purchase on Pro, with no price published.
Signals alerting is charged per alert sent, with no price published.
